limitations: Synthetic local measurements only; no scan/network/LLM workload. HTML/PDF export renders the synthetic session through the application export path. History paging uses a temporary 10000-row SQLite history. Compare equal machines, Python versions and fixture sizes. Peak memory is the traced Python allocation peak (tracemalloc), not OS-level process RSS. Offline test runtime is only recorded with --offline-tests and is not part of the fast microbenchmark.
